lens.alt: A copper filament bends and doubles as it passes behind the curved edge of a brightly refracting glass lens.
lens.caption: Refraction. AI-generated conceptual artwork.
lens.credit: AI-generated by OpenAI for Antebellum Gothic Science, 2026. Refraction. AI-generated conceptual artwork.
lens.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create art for an ambitious museum exhibition about antebellum scientific evidence and Gothic fiction. One edge of a giant hand-ground convex optical lens fills the right side of a horizontal 16:9 studio composition. Light grazes its immaculate curved edge then refracts into titanium blue, milky ivory, luminous celadon and a sudden intense copper spectral glint. A narrow suspended copper filament crosses the optical field on the right and is doubled and distorted by the glass. Extremely tactile photoreal macro studio still life, a few subtle trapped bubbles, sophisticated dark ultramarine ground, as if photographed with a large-format camera. The left third is almost completely quiet dark space for separate typography. The lens is a contemporary metaphor, not a historical device. No lettering, digits, captions, border, sparks or emblems.

sickroom.alt: A seated man holds his palm above the forearm of an awake man resting in bed. The two figures face each other in a daylit room.
sickroom.caption: Imagined mesmerism session in an American sickroom, circa 1845. AI-generated historical reconstruction.
sickroom.credit: AI-generated by OpenAI for Antebellum Gothic Science, 2026. Imagined mesmerism session in an American sickroom, circa 1845. AI-generated historical reconstruction.
sickroom.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. A horizontal cinematic color still, close to a stage reconstruction with honest physical lighting, American domestic sickroom circa 1845. Precise narrative focus: a fully dressed middle-aged male mesmerist with dark wool frock coat, waistcoat, white standing collar and narrow black cravat sits in profile beside the bed, holding one open relaxed hand about eight inches above the forearm of an alert awake adult man propped on white linen pillows. The patient watches the hand; no touching. The men's faces and hands tell the story. A plain painted plaster wall, small uncurtained sash window, dark wooden bed and subdued linen. Window light in cool ultramarine-gray shadows and warm copper daylight; warm skin tones and ivory linen. Deliberately composed wide side-on view with the two people and their hands shaped by an elegant declension of light, subtle fine grain, restrained museum documentary art direction. Period-correct modest New England material culture, no gas or electric fixtures, no wires, no stethoscope, no occult energy, no sepia, no text, no border. This is an imagined general scene, not a depiction of any named patient or event.

type.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create one horizontal cinematic museum illustration of the making of an 1840s American periodical. Low, tight, over-the-shoulder view across a printer's hand-composition bench. At center, a compositor's work-worn hands hold a small, period metal composing stick containing short rows of closely spaced, tiny, upside-down and reversed type. One finger positions a single rectangular metal sort by its sides. Behind the hands, an authentic worn wooden printer's type case has numerous shallow compartments of loose metal type, gently fading into shadow. We see rolled white linen shirt cuffs, no modern clothing or desk supplies. Strong raking daylight gives the tiny silver type heads and dark hands of metal beautiful highlights against matte charcoal, with blue-black shadows and warm honey wood. Fine-grained, exceptionally art directed and matter-of-fact. Tight framing; no printing press or faces needed. Types are very small, not legible, no visible words on paper, no labels or typography laid over the image. An imagined working scene, not a facsimile of a historical document. Landscape 16:9.

birthmark.alt: Georgiana studies her face in a looking glass. In the light from a window, a tiny hand-shaped mark is visible on her left cheek.
birthmark.caption: Georgiana at the looking glass. AI-generated literary illustration after Hawthorne’s “The Birth-Mark” (1843).
birthmark.credit: AI-generated by OpenAI for Antebellum Gothic Science, 2026. Georgiana at the looking glass. AI-generated literary illustration after Hawthorne’s “The Birth-Mark” (1843).
birthmark.prompt: Create a wide 16:9 cinematic literary illustration responding to Nathaniel Hawthorne’s story The Birth-Mark. An intimate portrait of Georgiana, a young adult woman in a late-eighteenth-century room, turning her face a little toward an antique looking glass. View her from her LEFT side in profile, her nose pointing toward the RIGHT edge of the frame, so her actual left cheek is clearly visible. On that cheek is one tiny, delicate, faint crimson birthmark, a miniature hand shape with five fine tapered finger-like branches. Small, subtle, flat, organic, not a graphic red stamp. Her expression is thoughtful and absorbed. Dress and hair suggest the later 1700s: a plain ivory linen fichu over a muted blue-gray gown, softly pinned hair, no Victorian collar. An aged mirror is angled away and contains only an indistinct reflection of the room and part of a shoulder, no second face. Use cool blue-black shadow, selective warm copper window light on her cheek, and careful tactile painterly realism; horizontal composition in the tradition of a carefully art-directed film still. No text, no border, no laboratory equipment, no distressed gestures or broken glass. This is an imagined fictional character, not a historical portrait.
